I just wanna hear what you guys think.

I could be completely wrong here but after playing with GP post-rework a few times, I think Tankplank's old it was better. The old E really helped the team engage and Tankplank did enough damage with Q and had utility on R to stay relevant. The barrels give him a lot more power in lane but it has been underwhelming in team fights, imo.

In my opinion Triforce rush is a must, the phage+barrel speed boost helps his mobility which is still lacking considering GP has no gap closer. In terms of build after Triforce there are two immediate paths I normally take. If I am bullying my opponent and farming with my Q well, then I start building IE because barrel crits hurt so much on squishy targets. If I cannot rush IE then I start building resistant items, normally Frozen Heart for armor and CD alongside Spirit Visage for health, MR and CD. And for a sixth item I am playing around with this still.

So core: Triforce, IE, Mercs or Tabi's, Frozen Heart, Spirit Visage, then Mallet seems the most promising IMO although Hydra works too.

Ap-plank is worthless because his heal is better as you have lower health so it's very effective still with only Visage.

For tips, mastering barrels is the core of GP's damage now. 60% armor ignoring Triforce procs already chunks hard, add in an IE for enhanced crit damage and you can take out the majority of an adc or apc's healthbar. Chaining barrels makes his threat range huge now.

Additional I find that Fire at Will is the best first upgrade because more procs on GP's Ult really adds up in a teamfight. From there I'd go Death's Daughter, unless you want a secondary engage tool in which case Raise Morale can act as an additional speedup.
